description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
There are three different types of Suzuki OEM Soft Top hardware parts in this kit.
This kit will provide you with a total solution to repair any missing or damaged snap parts that are located on either the softtop fabric, the Samurai side body, the Samurai tailgate or any combination of those.
Full Set – Male Snap w/Treaded Post (Bed Area)
Full Set – Brass Posts w/Treaded Post (Bed Area)
OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 Sets – Softtop Snap (includes both male (2) & female (2) pieces)
Qty 4 – Brass Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Tailgate
Qty 10 – Male Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Bodyside (5 per side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
